text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Also, have you noticed any difficulty with speaking, swallowing, or changes in your eyelids?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening weakness with activity and improvement with rest is very characteristic. Do you have any drooping of your eyelids, or does your facial expression change when you smile or raise your eyebrows?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To help narrow down the cause, have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids, especially later in the day, or any difficulty with swallowing and speaking? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of acetylcholine receptor antibodies confirms the diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
